title: Diploma in Music
tagline: Equipping worship leaders and musicians for faithful ministry and kingdom praise
description: The Diploma in Music equips students with both spiritual depth and technical musical excellence needed to lead worship assemblies and serve in music ministry. The program integrates music theory, instrument proficiency, vocal development, choral conducting, and worship theology.
whoFor: Designed for aspiring worship leaders, choir directors, church musicians, and vocalists who desire to integrate deep biblical theology with technical musical competence.
objectives: Develop comprehensive proficiency in music theory, ear training, and primary instruments.
Formulate a biblical theology of Christian worship and congregational praise.
Acquire practical vocal techniques, choir conducting, and ensemble arrangement skills.
Gain hands-on experience in sound engineering, music production, and live recital performance.
learningOutcomes: Mastery of fundamental and advanced music theory, ear training, and sight-reading.
Proficiency in primary instruments (keyboard/guitar) and vocal ensemble arrangement.
Ability to plan, lead, and evaluate Christ-centered congregational worship services.
Basic competency in live sound reinforcement, audio production, and team leadership.
eligibility: Completion of 10+2 (Higher Secondary) or equivalent
Basic musical aptitude (audition required live or via video)
Personal faith commitment and active local church involvement
Passion for worship leadership and musical ministry
admissionRequirements: Personal statement on music ministry calling

faq.question: Do I need to play an instrument already?
faq.answer: Basic musical ability is required, but you do not need to be an advanced musician. An audition helps us understand your current level and place you appropriately.

faq.question: What instruments are taught?
faq.answer: The program focuses on keyboard/piano and guitar as primary instruments, with ensemble opportunities on various instruments.

title: Diploma in Church Planting
tagline: Practical field training for frontline church planters and pioneer evangelists
description: The Diploma in Church Planting provides intensive, hands-on biblical and field training for pioneer evangelists and church planters called to establish local churches in unreached rural and urban villages.
whoFor: Ideal for pioneer workers, evangelists, lay leaders, and church planters seeking practical skills in cross-cultural evangelism, cell group leadership, and village church planting.
objectives: Master core principles of pioneer evangelism and cross-cultural church planting.
Develop practical skills in cell group leadership, discipleship, and village outreach.
Understand biblical models of church reproduction and indigenous ministry.
Engage in supervised field education and church planting practicums.
learningOutcomes: Ability to execute field-level pioneer evangelism and community engagement.
Skill in starting, nurturing, and multiplying cell groups into local assemblies.
Deep understanding of basic systematic theology and biblical exposition.
Competency in mentoring new believers and developing local lay leadership.
eligibility: Completion of 10th or 10+2 / High School
Proven recommendation from a local pastor or ministry supervisor
Heart for unreached village ministry and pioneer outreach
Willingness to participate in intensive field immersion
admissionRequirements: Personal statement of salvation and calling

faq.question: Is field immersion mandatory?
faq.answer: Yes, practical weekend and term field internships in unreached areas are an essential part of the Diploma in Church Planting.

title: Bachelor of Ministry & Church Planting
tagline: Equipping ministry practitioners for church expansion, pastoral care, and discipleship
description: The Bachelor of Ministry & Church Planting combines practical ministry skills with foundational biblical studies. It prepares graduates for active pastoral roles, evangelistic outreach, and establishing sustainable churches in diverse communities.
whoFor: Designed for students called to practical pastoral ministry, church planting, youth ministry, and community outreach who desire hands-on ministry training combined with biblical grounding.
objectives: Develop solid competency in biblical interpretation and expository teaching.
Acquire practical tools for planting, growing, and administering local congregations.
Gain hands-on experience in personal evangelism, counseling, and youth ministry.
Cultivate spiritual maturity, Christlike servant leadership, and ethical ministry practice.
learningOutcomes: Comprehensive knowledge of Old and New Testament doctrine and ministry application.
Proven ability to plan, launch, and pastor new church congregations.
Competency in personal and group discipleship, pastoral counseling, and conflict resolution.
Capacity to mobilize local believers for community transformation and missions.
eligibility: Completion of 10+2 (Higher Secondary) or equivalent
Personal testimony of faith and church recommendation letter
Proficiency in English or regional language
Willingness to engage in weekend ministry placements

faq.question: What is the primary focus of B.Min?
faq.answer: B.Min emphasizes practical hands-on ministry skills and church planting alongside biblical study, making it ideal for direct pastoral entry.

title: Bachelor of Theology & Church Planting
tagline: A foundational degree in biblical exegesis, systematic theology, and church planting
description: The Bachelor of Theology & Church Planting provides a comprehensive, academically rigorous foundation in Old and New Testament studies, biblical languages, systematic theology, church history, and strategic church planting.
whoFor: Designed for students seeking a rigorous theological foundation to prepare for pastoral ministry, Bible teaching, seminary teaching, or advanced postgraduate studies.
objectives: Develop a comprehensive, sound understanding of Old and New Testament Scriptures in original context.
Formulate a coherent biblical worldview grounded in systematic evangelical theology.
Gain practical skills in biblical preaching, pastoral care, and village church planting.
Cultivate personal spiritual maturity, servant leadership, and ethical integrity.
learningOutcomes: Mastery of Old and New Testament survey, exegesis, and biblical theology.
Ability to formulate and defend evangelical systematic theology.
Expository preaching and teaching competency.
Field skills for pioneer church planting and discipleship.
eligibility: Completion of 10+2 (Higher Secondary) or equivalent
Personal faith commitment and church recommendation
Proficiency in English (reading and writing)
Willingness to engage in community and practical ministry

faq.question: Is accommodation available for outstation students?
faq.answer: Yes, GEC offers hostel facilities for both male and female students. Contact admissions for availability and fees.

title: Master of Theology & Church Leadership
tagline: Advanced academic scholarship and executive leadership for educators and researchers
description: The Master of Theology & Church Leadership is a high-level academic research degree designed for scholars, seminary lecturers, and senior church leaders seeking specialization in theological disciplines and executive leadership.
whoFor: Intended for candidates holding a B.Th or M.Div who wish to pursue advanced scholarly research, academic teaching, theological authorship, or senior executive ecclesiastical leadership.
objectives: Conduct independent, original theological research utilizing advanced academic methodology.
Gain scholarly mastery in a chosen specialization (OT, NT, Systematic Theology, Church History).
Equip candidates for seminary lecturing, academic publication, and doctoral research.
Engage critically with contemporary global and contextual theological discourses.
learningOutcomes: Demonstrated mastery of research methodologies and academic thesis writing.
Advanced proficiency in exegesis, dogmatics, and historical theology.
Executive capability in institutional governance and academic leadership.
Preparation for doctoral-level studies (Ph.D. / Th.D.).
eligibility: M.Div or B.Th with distinction from an accredited seminary
Strong academic background with writing and research skills
Proficiency in English; knowledge of Biblical languages preferred
Approval of proposed research area
admissionRequirements: M.Div or B.Th with distinction (minimum 65% or equivalent)

faq.question: Can the M.Th lead to doctoral studies?
faq.answer: Yes. The M.Th is the standard preparation for doctoral (Ph.D. / Th.D.) studies in theology worldwide.

title: Master of Divinity & Church Leadership
tagline: The premier professional degree for pastoral leadership, preaching, and church multiplication
description: The Master of Divinity & Church Leadership is the gold-standard professional ministry degree for ordained pastoral leadership, senior church governance, expository preaching, and national church planting movements.
whoFor: Designed for university graduates and ministry leaders called to senior pastoral leadership, church multiplication, executive administration, and ordained ministry.
objectives: Master advanced exegesis of Biblical texts in Hebrew and Greek original contexts.
Develop executive leadership, church administration, and strategic mission capability.
Integrate theological scholarship with practical pastoral care and expository preaching excellence.
Analyze contemporary cultural and ethical challenges from a biblical perspective.
learningOutcomes: Expository Preaching Excellence: Crafting and delivering biblically faithful, culturally engaging sermons.
Advanced Original Language Exegesis: Translating and interpreting Old Testament Hebrew and New Testament Greek.
Executive Church Governance: Managing church administration, financial stewardship, and ministry teams.
Strategic Church Planting: Planning, launching, and sustaining self-reproducing congregations.
Pastoral Care & Counseling: Providing compassionate, biblically grounded care in complex pastoral situations.
Contextual Theology & Worldview: Engaging modern secularism, cults, and religious pluralism with apologetic clarity.
eligibility: Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution (B.A., B.Sc., B.Com, B.Tech or B.Th)
Personal testimony of faith and local church recommendation letter
English language proficiency
Commitment to full-time or modular ministry study

faq.question: What is the difference between M.Div and M.Th?
faq.answer: The M.Div is a professional ministry degree focused on pastoral and ministry leadership. The M.Th is an academic research degree for those pursuing advanced scholarship or teaching.
